abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Argus screenshots dated 2026-08-02. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.description: Muriel's damaging abilities reduce Enemy Healing by 25.0/25.0/25.0/25.0/25.0/25.0/35.0/35.0/35.0/35.0/35.0/35.0/45.0/45.0/45.0/45.0/45.0/45.0/35.0/45.0% for 4s. Allies affected by Muriel's abilities gain 12% (+0.5% per Level) increased Healing and Shielding Received for 4s.

abilities.name: Consecrated Ground
abilities.description: Sanctify the ground with an angelic light for 6s. Allies within the area gain 10.0/12.5/15.0/17.5/20.0% Total Attack Speed and restore 60.0/80.0/100.0/120.0/140.0 (+20% magical power) Health over its lifetime. Enemies within the area have their Total Attack Speed reduced by 10.0/11.5/13.0/14.5/16.0% and receive 90.0/120.0/150.0/180.0/210.0 (+50% magical power) magical damage over its lifetime.

abilities.name: Alacrity
abilities.description: Throw an orb that applies a 80.0/120.0/160.0/200.0/240.0 (+60% magical power) shield to the first Allied Hero it touches, granting them 15.0/17.5/20.0/22.5/25.0% Decaying Movement Speed for 4s. Remains in the world for 8s if untouched.

abilities.name: Serenity
abilities.description: Charge a piercing bolt of energy for up to 4s that deals 70.0/105.0/140.0/175.0/210.0 (+50% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path and Slows by 35% for 1.0/1.1/1.1/1.1/1.2s. If Muriel charges Serenity for 1.1s it reaches max charge and deals 98.0/147.0/196.0/245.0/294.0 (+70% magical power) magical damage and Stuns the target for 1.0/1.1/1.1/1.1/1.2s instead. If Muriel cancels the charge, 50% of the cooldown and 50% of the cost is refunded.

abilities.name: Reversal Of Fortune
abilities.description: Prepare for flight, allowing Muriel to target an Allied Hero anywhere in the world, granting them 35% Damage Reduction and a 280.0/480.0/680.0 (+100% magical power) Shield for 2.5s as you soar to their location. On arrival, nearby Enemies take 100.0/160.0/220.0 (+40% magical power) magical damage and are Knocked Up for 0.5s.

augments.name: Circuit Reset
augments.description: Upon Shielding a Hero with Alacrity, reduce their Current Ability Cooldowns by 1.5s.

augments.name: Sacrosanct
augments.description: Casting Reversal of Fortune on an Allied Hero immediately creates a Consecrated Ground at the current level at the target location.

augments.name: Essence Nullifier
augments.description: Serenity's Max Charge Damage also drains 10 (+3.0/4.5/6.0/7.5/9.0% Target's Current Mana) Mana, dealing it as true damage.
